question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded Control UI composer modal for long prompts, or handle this friction through inline composer growth/resizing and the existing send-shortcut setting?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing composition mode and draft/send workflow rather than fixing a broken documented contract, so automation should not choose the UX direction alone.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Ergonomics
options.body: Improve long prompts through inline growth, resizing, or the existing shortcut preference without adding another composition mode.

options.title: Decline Modal Direction
options.body: Close the request by maintainer decision if the Control UI composer should stay lean and modal composition should not live in core.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this issue and have adjacent product signal from the merged send-shortcut direction.
